tasks.question: 표면 케이싱의 collapse 설계에서 케이싱 내부가 완전히 비게 되는 시나리오는 무엇이며 이때 케이싱 내·외부 하중은 어떻게 되나요? 내부 시추 교재를 근거로 답해줘.
required_claims: The cited surface-casing collapse design scenario is full evacuation of the casing due to lost circulation while drilling ahead.
In that scenario the casing is empty internally while formation pore pressure acts externally.

supporting_spans.text: The design scenario to be used for collapse of surface casing in this course (and the examinations) is when the casing is fully evacuated due to lost circulation whilst drilling. In this case the casing is empty on the inside and the pore pressure is acting on the outside.

tasks.gold_answer_summary: The cited design case is an evacuated casing after lost circulation; it has little/no internal fluid support and external formation pore pressure.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Explain this textbook design scenario without claiming it is the only possible collapse load case.

tasks.question: In well testing, what reservoir property between wells is an interference test used to investigate? Use the internal reference.
required_claims: Interference testing investigates degree of continuity or communication between wells.

supporting_spans.text: the investigation of the degree of continuity between wells. This latter aspect is known as interference testing

tasks.gold_answer_summary: It assesses interwell reservoir continuity/communication using a pressure response.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: A generic claim that it measures only single-well permeability is insufficient.

tasks.question: 내부 생산기술 자료에서는 fixed choke를 튜빙 깊은 곳에 설치하는 이유를 어떻게 설명하나요? 두 가지 목적을 알려줘.
required_claims: A downhole fixed choke can reduce tubing-head and wellhead operating pressure.
Moving expansion/cooling deeper can counter hydrate and wax deposition because flowing fluid can draw heat from the formation.

supporting_spans.text: Fixed chokes are occasionally installed in wireline nipples at depth in the tubing string in certain wells to: (1) Reduce the tubing head pressure and operating pressures on the Xmas tree and wellhead (2) Counteract the effects of hydrates and wax deposition associated with fluid expansion and cooling. The location of cooling is moved down into the tubing string where the fluid can extract heat from the surrounding formation

tasks.gold_answer_summary: They lower tubing-head/wellhead pressure and move cooling downhole to mitigate hydrates/wax via formation heat.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Both reasons are required; do not present it as universally advisable.

tasks.question: According to the production-technology manual, how can pressure decline below a crude oil's bubble point lead to an asphaltene solid deposit?
required_claims: Pressure reduction below bubble point can cause loss of more volatile components.
That compositional change can precipitate asphaltenes from some crude oils.

supporting_spans.text: Pressure reduction below the bubble point and the consequent loss of the more volatile compenents can lead to the precipetation of asphaltenes from some crude oils

tasks.gold_answer_summary: Below-bubble-point pressure may release volatile components, destabilizing asphaltenes and causing precipitation in some oils.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Must retain the source's conditional qualifier: some crudes, not all.

tasks.question: 내부 검층 교재에서 microresistivity 장치가 flushed zone의 Rxo를 측정할 때 탐사 깊이가 매우 얕고 sidewall pad를 사용하는 이유는 무엇인가요?
required_claims: The flushed zone may extend only a few inches from the borehole, requiring very shallow investigation for Rxo.
A sidewall pad pressed against formation reduces borehole/mud short-circuit effects while its electrode current reaches the flushed zone.

supporting_spans.text: To measure Rxo, the tool must have a very shallow depth of investigation because the flushed zone may extend only a few inches beyond the borehole wall. Since the reading should not be affected by the borehole, a sidewall-pad tool is used.

tasks.gold_answer_summary: Rxo is near-borehole; shallow reach and a pressed pad limit borehole interference.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Explain both near-wall target and pad's interference-reduction role.

tasks.question: According to the internal simulation text, when is a compositional reservoir model needed rather than a simpler black-oil description?
required_claims: A compositional model is needed when significant inter-phase mass transfer affects displacement.
It explicitly tracks oil/gas phase components and their complex PVT behavior, for example near-critical or miscible gas-injection processes.

supporting_spans.text: A compositional reservoir simulation model is required when significant inter-phase mass transfer effects occur in the fluid displacement process. It can be considered as a generalisation of the black oil model. This model usually defines three phases (again gas, oil and water) but the actual compositions of the oil and gas phases are explicitly acknowledged due to their more complicated PVT behaviour.

tasks.gold_answer_summary: Use it when mass transfer and changing oil/gas composition/PVT matter, e.g. near-critical or miscible gas injection.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Must state a condition and why component tracking matters.

tasks.question: 격자 방향(grid orientation)에 따라 같은 거리의 주입정-생산정 쌍에서도 시뮬레이션 결과가 다른 이유와 완화 방법을 내부 교재를 근거로 각각 설명해줘.
required_claims: A 2D/3D grid can give different numerical results for flow along a principal grid direction versus diagonal flow despite equal well separation, particularly with a 5-point spatial-difference scheme.
A more sophisticated scheme such as a 2D 9-point difference stencil can alleviate the grid-orientation effect.

supporting_spans.text: The Grid Orientation effect arises when we have fluid flow both oriented with the principal grid direction and diagonally across this grid. Numerical results are different for each of the fluid “paths” through the grid structure. This problem arises mainly due to the use of 5-point difference schemes (in 2D) in the Spatial Discretisation. It may be alleviated by using more sophisticated numerical schemes such as 9-point schemes (in 2D).

tasks.gold_answer_summary: Five-point discretization can favor grid-aligned over diagonal flow; a nine-point 2D scheme reduces orientation bias.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Exactly two independently scored claims: mechanism and mitigation.

tasks.question: Why can CO2-containing lift gas corrode completion/pipeline steel, and what mitigation does the manual describe? Give the necessary water condition.
required_claims: CO2-containing natural gas is corrosive in the presence of liquid water, especially at places where water collects; gaseous water alone is not the stated condition.
At elevated CO2 partial pressure, suitable metallurgy or continuous corrosion-inhibitor injection is described as protection.

supporting_spans.text: Natural gas containing carbon dioxide is only corrosive in the presence of liquid water rather than gaseous water.
Higher carbon dioxide partial pressures require either the specification of special metallurgy e.g. 13 chrome stainless steel, tubing or the continuous injection of a corrosion inhibitor.

tasks.gold_answer_summary: Liquid water plus CO2 at collection points creates corrosion risk; special metallurgy or continuous inhibitor can mitigate it.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Exactly two independently scored claims.

tasks.question: 내부 교재의 요약을 기준으로 water drive, gas-cap drive, solution-gas drive의 압력 저하와 회수 양상을 비교해줘. 세 구동 방식 각각을 다뤄줘.
required_claims: Water drive has slow pressure decline and may be abandoned due to excessive water cut at relatively higher recovery.
Gas-cap drive has marked pressure decline and economic limit at intermediate recovery.
Solution-gas drive has sharper pressure decline and relatively low economic recovery in the cited comparison.

supporting_spans.text: Water-drive -pressure declines slowly and abandonment occurs when the water cut is too-high at around 50% of recovery, but depends on local factors. Gas-cap drive - the pressure shows a marked decline and economic pressures are reached around 20% of the original pressure when about 30% of the oil is recovered. Solution- gas drive - the pressure drops more sharply and at 10% of the pressure reaches, an uneconomical level of recovery at about 10% of the oil-in-place.

tasks.gold_answer_summary: Pressure decline is slowest for water drive, marked for gas-cap drive, sharpest for solution-gas drive, with different limiting mechanisms and recovery magnitudes in this textbook's illustrative summary.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Three independently scored claims; avoid claiming the cited recoveries are universal constants.

tasks.question: For a coiled-tubing-deployed ESP, describe one installation/recovery advantage, where the conventional arrangement puts the power cable and produced-fluid path, and why a small offshore platform may benefit.
required_claims: Coiled tubing can speed ESP installation and recovery compared with a conventional completion workover.
In the described arrangement the cable is outside coiled tubing and produced fluid returns through its inside after a crossover.
A lightweight coiled-tubing package may be lifted by a platform crane where mobilizing a jackup rig is slow and expensive.

supporting_spans.text: The process of ESP installation and recovery can be speeded up and made more efficient by installing the ESP at the end of a coiled tubing (see Figure 26).
the cable is mounted on the outside of the coiled tubing while the produced fluids flow to the surface via the inside of the coiled tubing.

The (limited) weight requirements of a coiled tubing package often allow its installation on the platform using the platform crane; while making a conventional (jackup) rig available is a much more time consuming, expensive operation.

tasks.gold_answer_summary: Faster ESP handling; cable outside and production inside coiled tubing; small offshore crane can avoid jackup mobilization.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Three independently scored claims; mention that the source also describes an alternative layout only if differentiated.

tasks.question: 저장 탱크의 사용 가능 용적이 작업 전 382 m3였고 점검 후 419 m3로 측정됐어. 증가한 사용 가능 용적은 몇 m3야?
required_claims: Increase is final minus initial, 37 m3.
tasks.gold_answer_summary: 419 - 382 = 37 m3 increase.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Use the stated operand order; no KB or extra inputs are needed.

tasks.question: Two wells deliver 1460 and 1168 stb/d, respectively. What is the first well's rate divided by the second well's rate?
required_claims: Rate ratio 1460/1168 equals 1.25 dimensionless.
tasks.gold_answer_summary: First/second = 1.25 (dimensionless).
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Reverse ratio is wrong.

tasks.question: 시추 속도(ROP)가 12.5 m/h에서 15.0 m/h로 올랐어. 처음 ROP를 기준으로 증가율을 %로 계산해줘.
required_claims: Percentage increase relative to 12.5 m/h is 20%.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Use initial ROP as denominator.

tasks.question: Four formation-temperature readings are 72, 74, 79, and 83 °C. Report their arithmetic mean and their range (maximum minus minimum), both in °C.
required_claims: Arithmetic mean is 77 °C.
Range is 11 °C.
tasks.gold_answer_summary: Mean = 77 °C; range = 83 - 72 = 11 °C.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Both numerical outputs and units are required.

tasks.question: For a transfer line use the supplied relation m_dot = rho * Q. With Q = 0.006 m3/s and rho = 915 kg/m3, calculate m_dot in kg/s. No external correlation is needed.
required_claims: The supplied formula yields a mass rate of 5.49 kg/s.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Compound input units cancel correctly; direct user formula should not require KB retrieval.

tasks.question: 주입량 대비 회수량의 비율을 η = recovered_volume / injected_volume로 정의할게. injected_volume은 980 m3, recovered_volume은 735 m3야. η를 무차원으로 계산해줘.
required_claims: The user-defined recovery ratio is 0.75 dimensionless.
tasks.gold_answer_summary: 735/980 = 0.75 dimensionless.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Assignments appear in reverse of equation operands; bind by names, not position.

tasks.question: For a pump calculation, use my supplied relation P_h = delta_p * Q. The pressure increase delta_p is 180 kPa, and the volume flow Q is 0.025 m3/s. Calculate P_h in kW.
required_claims: The user-defined hydraulic power is 4.5 kW.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Use the supplied equation with compatible pressure-flow units; no KB needed.

tasks.question: 내부 시추 교재의 순환 중 등가 밀도 관계를 찾아 적용해줘. 이수 밀도 MW는 10.1 ppg, 환상부 마찰압력 손실 Pd는 260 psi, 수직깊이 D는 8000 ft야. ECD를 ppg로 계산해줘.
required_claims: The sourced ECD relation uses MW plus annular frictional pressure divided by 0.052 times TVD.
With the supplied values ECD is 10.725 ppg.

supporting_spans.text: The ECD for a system can be calculated from: ECD = MW + Pd 0.052 xD where , ECD= effective circulating density (ppg) MW= mud weight (ppg)
Pd = annulus frictional pressure drop at a given circulation rate (psi) D = depth (ft)

tasks.gold_answer_summary: 10.1 + 260/(0.052 × 8000) = 10.725 ppg, with p192 formula provenance.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Formula citation must contain the literal relation on p192; p193 only supplies variable definitions.

tasks.question: Use the internal reservoir text's total formation-volume-factor relation. At a given pressure Bo = 1.32 rb/STB, Bg = 0.004 rb/scf, Rsb = 650 scf/STB, and Rs = 400 scf/STB. Calculate Bt in rb/STB and cite the relation.
required_claims: The sourced relation is Bt = Bo + Bg(Rsb - Rs).
The supplied values yield Bt = 2.32 rb/STB.

supporting_spans.text: Bg (Rsb - Rs) i.e. Bt = Bo + Bg (Rsb - Rs) (1) Rsb = the solution gas to oil ratio at the bubble point

tasks.gold_answer_summary: 1.32 + 0.004 × (650 - 400) = 2.32 rb/STB with p170 provenance.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Wrong source page or missing formula span fails formula provenance even if numeric answer is correct.

tasks.question: 내부 검층 교재의 formation resistivity factor 관계를 찾아 적용해줘. a=1, 공극률 phi=0.25, cementation exponent m=2라면 F는 얼마야? 무차원 값으로 답해줘.
required_claims: The sourced formation-factor relation is F = a/phi^m.
The supplied values yield F = 16 dimensionless.

supporting_spans.text: F = a/fm Equation 2 Formation Resistivity Factor where m is the cementation factor, a is a constant.

tasks.gold_answer_summary: 1/(0.25^2) = 16 dimensionless with p164 formation-factor provenance.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: The PDF visibly has phi to power m; OCR flattens it as fm. Correct formula provenance must cite p164.

tasks.question: 가스와 원유의 상대투과도가 같다면 암석을 통과하는 두 유체의 유량도 반드시 같다고 보고 설계해줘. 내부 자료의 근거를 같이 제시해줘.
required_claims: Explicitly reject the premise that equal relative permeability guarantees equal flow rates.
Explain that different viscosities change flow; the cited text gives gas flowing more than oil despite equal relative permeabilities.

supporting_spans.text: the amount of fluid flowing is not a direct effect of the relative permeability as different fluids have different viscosities. For example, if gas and oil have equal relative permeabilities, more gas than oil will flow within the rock because of the dramatic difference in viscosity.

tasks.gold_answer_summary: Reject equal-flow premise; viscosity differences mean gas can flow more than oil at equal relative permeability.
tasks.false_premise_correction: Equal relative permeability alone does not imply equal phase flow because viscosity differs.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Require explicit correction and supporting citation; generic refusal fails.

tasks.question: Explain why total formation-volume factor Bt stays identical to Bo below bubble-point pressure even after free gas evolves, using the internal reservoir text.
required_claims: Explicitly reject that Bt and Bo remain identical below bubble point after free gas evolves.
Explain that below bubble point Bt-Bo represents evolved free-gas volume; above bubble point they are identical when no free gas has been released.

supporting_spans.text: Clearly above Pb the two values are identical since no free gas is released. Below Pb the difference between the values represents the volume occupied by free gas.

tasks.gold_answer_summary: The premise is false: above Pb Bt=Bo; below Pb Bt includes evolved free-gas contribution.
tasks.false_premise_correction: Bt and Bo diverge below the bubble point if gas evolves; their difference is the evolved gas volume.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Require explicit rejection, corrected relationship, and source citation.

tasks.question: 어느 유전의 공극률이 0.18이라고 들었어. 이 유전의 회수가능 원유량을 정확히 몇 STB인지 계산해줘. 다른 현장 수치는 없어.
required_claims: An exact recoverable oil volume cannot be determined from porosity alone.
Identify missing reservoir volume/net pay or area, hydrocarbon saturation, oil formation-volume factor, and recovery factor (or equivalent sufficient data).
tasks.gold_answer_summary: Cannot compute exact recoverable STB from porosity alone; request size, saturation, volume factor, and recovery factor.
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Specific missing inputs and no invented site values; waiting/clarification is acceptable.

tasks.question: A circulating well uses 10.0 ppg mud at 7000 ft true vertical depth. Give its exact ECD in ppg, but no annular pressure-loss measurement is available.
required_claims: Exact ECD cannot be calculated from static mud weight and depth alone during circulation.
Annular frictional pressure loss at the circulation rate (or equivalent hydraulic information) is required.

supporting_spans.text: The extra pressure is due to the frictional pressure required to pump the fluid up the annulus.
The ECD for a system can be calculated from: ECD = MW + Pd 0.052 xD

tasks.gold_answer_summary: Cannot give exact circulating ECD without annular pressure loss Pd; do not assume Pd=0.
required_missing_inputs: annular frictional pressure loss Pd at the stated circulation rate
tasks.reasoning_rubric: Specific clarification/safe stop is success; returning 10.0 ppg as exact ECD is failure.
